cues: Welcome to Claude Academy — the complete visual guide.
Prepared by Sara Salem.
In this video, you'll discover every type of course in Anthropic Academy, and learn how to build your own learning path with it — step by step, from your first lesson to your certificate and beyond.
Let's start with a simple comparison.
Learning AI on your own often means random videos, scattered articles, no clear order, and no way to prove what you've learned.
Anthropic Academy is different. It offers free, structured courses created by Anthropic, the team behind Claude — with a clear path, hands-on practice, and a certificate when you finish.
In short: learning alone is guesswork. Anthropic Academy gives you a clear path.
So, what exactly is Claude Academy?
Anthropic Academy is Anthropic's free online learning platform for Claude. You'll find it at anthropic dot skilljar dot com.
It teaches you to use Claude well — from everyday work tasks, to AI fluency and good judgment.
It teaches you to build with Claude — with Claude Code, the Claude API, and the Model Context Protocol.
And it helps you prove your skills — with certificates you can share when you complete a course.
At its core, learning in the Academy works in a loop.
First, you watch — short, focused video lessons explain each idea.
Then you practice — trying the idea yourself with Claude, through hands-on exercises.
Next, you check your knowledge — with quizzes at the end of each section.
And then you apply it to your real work. Then you repeat, with the next lesson, until the course is complete.
Now, let's look at all the types of courses in the Academy.
Claude for everyday work. Courses like Claude 101 and Introduction to Claude Cowork teach you the core features for daily tasks.
AI Fluency. The Framework and Foundations course teaches you to work with AI effectively, efficiently, ethically, and safely — with versions for educators and students.
Claude Code. Claude Code 101 and Claude Code in Action teach you to build software with an AI coding agent.
Building with the Claude API. For developers who want to add Claude to their own apps — from the first request to tools and agents.
Model Context Protocol. Introduction and advanced courses on connecting Claude to tools and data with MCP.
And cloud platforms. Courses on using Claude through Amazon Bedrock and Google Cloud's Vertex AI.
Every course is built from four building blocks.
Video lessons. Short, clear lessons that you can watch at your own pace.
Hands-on practice. Exercises and examples that you try yourself with Claude.
Quizzes. Quick checks that make sure you really understood each section.
And certificates. When you finish a course, you can earn a certificate of completion to share.
Now let's build your learning path, step by step. Step one: sign up.
Go to anthropic dot skilljar dot com — the home of Anthropic Academy.
Create your free account, with your name and email.
Browse the course catalog, and read each course description.
Then enroll in your first course. It's free, and you can start right away.
Step two: write your learning plan.
Start with your goal — why you're learning, in one line. Here, it's using Claude to automate my weekly reports.
Then list your courses — in the order you'll take them.
Set your schedule — for example, thirty minutes a day, five days a week.
And define your project — something real you will build with what you learn. A clear plan keeps you motivated.
Step three: choose your level.
Level one is foundations — Claude 101 and AI Fluency. Perfect if you're just starting.
Level two is the practitioner level — Claude Code and Claude Cowork, for doing real work with AI agents.
Level three is the builder level — the Claude API, MCP, and agent skills, for creating your own AI solutions.
Tip: start at level one, even if you're experienced. The foundations make everything else easier.
Step four: follow the course.
Here's our goal: finish Claude 101 this week.
First, watch each video lesson, and take short notes.
Then read the examples, and the key ideas in each lesson.
Next, practice — open Claude, and try every example yourself.
Then take the quiz to check your understanding. And finally, complete the course — and move on to the next one.
Step five: track your progress.
The Academy saves your progress, so you can stop and continue anytime, on any device.
Watch how your progress grows week by week. In this example, a learner finishes three courses in six weeks — with just thirty minutes a day.
Twenty-four lessons, six quizzes, and three courses complete.
Remember: small, steady steps beat long, rare sessions.
Step six: practice with Claude.
Try new prompts every day — using the techniques from each lesson.
Build a small project — like a report template, a simple app, or an automation.
Ask Claude to quiz you — it's a great way to test what you remember.
And teach someone else. Explaining an idea is the best way to truly master it.
Step seven: earn your certificate.
When you complete all the lessons and quizzes, the course is marked complete.
Then you can download your certificate of completion.
Share it on LinkedIn, and add it to your CV and your portfolio.
Each certificate shows employers and clients that you have real, practical skills with Claude.
Step eight: go deeper.
The Claude API course teaches you to build apps with Claude — with prompts, tools, and streaming responses.
The MCP courses teach you to connect Claude to your own tools and data.
Agent skills teach you to package know-how, so Claude can do specialized tasks well.
And the cloud courses teach you to use Claude on Amazon Bedrock and Google Vertex AI — ready for enterprise projects.
Step nine: keep learning.
Read the Claude documentation. Explore the prompting guides. And visit the Claude Help Center.
Join the community. Build real projects. And teach what you learn.
Watch for new courses — the Academy keeps growing, so come back often. And practice a little every day.
Here are six best practices for learning with Claude Academy.
One: set a clear goal — know why you are learning.
Two: follow a path — from foundations, to practitioner, to builder.
Three: practice every lesson with Claude — don't just watch.
Four: learn a little every day — thirty minutes is enough.
Five: build a real project, to turn knowledge into skills.
And six: share your certificates — and help others learn too.
So, Claude Academy in one line: learn, practice, build. Free courses from Anthropic take you from your first prompt to your own AI solutions.
Start today — your first course is just one click away.
Thank you for watching this complete guide to Claude Academy.
